title: Graves Without Names
summary: Someone has been burying raiders, strays, and husks outside a desert village. Follow the fresh graves to an old pyramid and find the undertaker responsible.

dialogue.intro: Someone has been burying the dead outside the village. Raiders. Strays. Even husks. We did not ask for a cemetery.
offer: Because the graves are fresh, the bodies are not ours, and whoever digs them comes after sunset.
Only at a distance. A dead man carrying a shovel bright enough to catch the sun.
Toward the old pyramid. Nobody here is volunteering to follow them.
What do you want me to do?
Find out whether he is burying corpses... or collecting them.
dialogue.return: So there really is an undertaker in the pyramid.
dialogue.reward: Take this. I still do not like him, but a creature that buries raiders instead of joining them is a problem I can postpone.
dialogue.done: The graves are still appearing. They are straighter than ours, which is irritating.

quest_book.title: Burial Ledger of Qasra
quest_book.author: Amar
pages:
BURIAL LEDGER

Unnamed traveler. Found west of the village. No possessions worth recording.
Two raiders. One red sash, one broken crossbow. Buried separately. They argued enough while alive.
Stray. No name. Arrow removed before burial. Professional courtesy.
Husk. No marks. Sand in the lungs, though that seems redundant.
Child of Qasra. Name damaged on the old token. Reburied beneath clean stone.
Three pillagers. No one claimed them. This is not the same as no one having loved them.

Amar.
Undertaker.
Grave prepared.
Occupant absent.

I have delayed the final entry again.

This is becoming unprofessional.

goals.completion_dialogue_line: The grave-robber collapses beside the burial chamber. A shovel scrapes across stone somewhere behind you.

threats.name: Varek the Grave-Robber
threats.target_line: Dead men don't need valuables. Walk away.

threats.name: Amar the Undertaker
talk: Because you have already killed him. There is no need to be rude afterward.
Then his professional judgment was poor. His burial does not need to be.
I am burying bodies. Monsters are a matter for people with more philosophical free time.
Amar. Undertaker. The first name was mine. The profession appears to have survived me.
Yes. I have filed the complaint.
Dry stone. Deep rooms. Few relatives object to the location, and the dead have shown no preference.
Your ledger has an empty grave.
Why have you not used it?
Because I cannot locate the body with sufficient confidence. This is embarrassing in my profession.
threats.attack_choice_label: You're adding one more grave today.
threats.spare_choice_label: I'm not here to stop you. Tell me about your grave.
threats.attack_return_line: Amar falls beside the graves he kept for others. His own remains empty.
threats.post_spare_line: There is one burial I have postponed longer than is professionally defensible.

mercy_outcome.offer_line: Help me find where they took my body. After that, I may finally complete the ledger.
